name: Jet Jammer - Crit DMG
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Crit DMG capability.

61243.name: Flying Device I · Crit DMG
61243.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
In combat, the enemy's Crit DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
